answer: Count the divergence, then slash. Draw five jurors per submission, require four to agree, and slash any juror whose verdict sits more than one grade off the final panel. Void the audit if the panel collapses onto one operator or one subnet, because a homogeneous jury is a signature, not a review. Honest work costs one answer plus one review; a fake identity costs a bond, a distinct thread of history, and four agreeing jurors. The cheapest attack now sits above the ridge of honest work, and no farm reaches the summit by undercutting it.
